work_orders.title: Cold weather watch: methanol injection at max rate

notes.text: 3 PM: Methanol pump set to max for the cold snap. Scrubber dumping more often than normal today.
5 PM day shift: heat trace on the instrument rack and sensing lines checked earlier this week (runs on utility power). Discharge PSVs on all units are set at 1200 psig.

dispatch_jobs.reason: Station utility power failure at 18:04 in -8F cold snap. PLC/comms on UPS. Heat trace for instrument rack/sensing lines (utility powered) is lost, so there is risk of frozen sensing lines and false pressure readings. Methanol injection status unknown, and the scrubber is filling faster than normal. Need power restored or a generator, plus verification of instruments, heat trace and methanol pump.
